attribution_limitations: Table 1 lists discharge date 2023.09.16 (POD 123) and expired date 2023.09.16 (POD 123, ICH) on the same date; narrative says the patient died the day after POD 122 without a discharge.

"Amelioration of lung function due to left upper pneumothorax" is contradictory in direction; Figure 2C caption describes left septated pneumothorax. Complete inotropic-off at POD 51 (Table 1) coexists with "complete weaning from the inotropes difficult".
Right pneumothorax after ECMO (Fig 2A) vs left upper/septated pneumothorax later (Fig 2C); the laterality change is as stated and not reconciled. Number/dates of closed thoracostomies unstated.

Discussion cites an autopsy case of a 29-year-old with sudden cardiac arrest (ref B10, Korean J Leg Med); this is an external published patient, not Case 2 (who died of ICH), and is excluded from Case 2.

Hospital day 15 (scheduled LVAD date) and the Table 1 implant date 2023.05.16 imply admission about 1 May 2023, but the admission date is not stated; text says three HF hospitalizations within 6 months in 2023 before transfer.
